lastCompletedStory.title: Add selectAdapter(backend) factory and wire the four dispatch call sites

nextStoryContext: selectAdapter(backend: string): BackendAdapter now lives in src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts ('codex' -> CodexAdapter, everything else including unknown values -> ClaudeAdapter). All four dispatch call sites now actually route through it: loop.ts's implement branch (selectAdapter(implBackend).buildSpawnArgv('implementer', {...}), replacing the buildImplementerWorkerArgv(...) call and its now-removed import), review.ts's reviewDispatch (selectAdapter(reviewBackend).buildSpawnArgv('reviewer', {...})), and plan-runner.ts's resolveAndSpawnPlanner/resolveAndSpawnAuditor (selectAdapter(backend).buildSpawnArgv('planner'|'auditor', {...}), replacing the buildPlannerWorkerArgv/buildAuditorWorkerArgv import from plan-argv.ts). The four thin per-actor wrapper functions (buildImplementerWorkerArgv, buildReviewerWorkerArgv, buildPlannerWorkerArgv, buildAuditorWorkerArgv) are UNCHANGED and still exported (still hardcode `new ClaudeAdapter()` internally) -- they are only still consumed directly by their own dedicated golden/model test files now, no production call site imports them anymore. Back-compat is exact: readPhaseBackend defaults to 'claude' everywhere no [backend] config exists (DEFAULTS.backend = 'claude' in config/models.ts), so every existing test asserting a specific claude argv golden (loop.test.ts, review.test.ts, plan tests) passed unmodified through the new selectAdapter indirection -- this IS the AC3 byte-identical back-compat proof, reinforced by an explicit selectAdapter('claude') === new ClaudeAdapter() equality test added to backend-adapter.test.ts. Two file-size ceilings were raised (loop.ts 2419->2422, plan-runner.ts 1711->1717) in scripts/file-size-budget.json for the added selectAdapter call sites + comments; _ref updated accordingly. Remaining gap for a future story: src/commands/run.ts's orchestrator backend (orchBackend, line ~425) is still deliberately on the old readBackend() global read (documented, not this story's scope) -- and there is still no per-actor completion-detection story for codex (readWorkerTokens / worker-report sentinel parsing has no codex-shaped equivalent yet), so flipping any [backend].<phase> = "codex" in project.toml today will spawn codex correctly but the supervisor's own outcome-detection path is unvalidated against a real codex run.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal wiring: selectAdapter(backend) dispatches between two already-implemented (and already docs-validated in US-001) adapters. No new external library surface touched.
